<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>

    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="29" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>

  <rect x="369" y="12" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="385" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <rect x="0" y="29" width="390" height="111" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
  <polyline points="28,78 20,85 28,92" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>

  <text x="195" y="103" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Verify your profile</text>
  <text x="195" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Confirm your selfie to complete verification</text>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <text x="22" y="166" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Review your photos</text>
  <text x="22" y="187" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Make sure your face is clear and easy to recognize.</text>

  <!-- Photo cards shadows -->
  <rect x="20" y="204" width="168" height="150" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>
  <rect x="202" y="204" width="168" height="150" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>

  <!-- Submitted selfie card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="201" width="168" height="150" rx="12" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="20" y="201" width="168" height="28" rx="12" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".82"/>
    <rect x="20" y="217" width="168" height="12" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".82"/>
    <text x="32" y="220" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">SUBMITTED SELFIE</text>
    <circle cx="104" cy="263" r="26" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="104" cy="318" rx="43" ry="31" fill="#7D8490"/>
    <circle cx="95" cy="259" r="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>

    <polyline points="151,333 155,337 163,328" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile photo comparison card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="202" y="201" width="168" height="150" rx="12" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="202" y="201" width="168" height="28" rx="12" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".82"/>
    <rect x="202" y="217" width="168" height="12" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".82"/>

    <circle cx="286" cy="263" r="26" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <ellipse cx="286" cy="318" rx="43" ry="31" fill="#939393"/>

    <polyline points="333,333 337,337 345,328" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <text x="20" y="373" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Front-facing, recent</text>
  <text x="202" y="373" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your profile reference</text>

  <!-- Requirements -->
  <rect x="20" y="396" width="350" height="176" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="38" y="426" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Verification requirements</text>
  <circle cx="45" cy="453" r="10" fill="#96E063"/>
  <polyline points="40,453 44,457 51,449" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="66" y="458" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Your face is fully visible</text>
  <line x1="38" y1="472" x2="352" y2="472" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="497" r="10" fill="#96E063"/>
  <polyline points="40,497 44,501 51,493" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="66" y="502" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">No sunglasses or face coverings</text>
  <line x1="38" y1="516" x2="352" y2="516" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="541" r="10" fill="#96E063"/>
  <polyline points="40,541 44,545 51,537" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="66" y="546" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Photo matches your profile</text>

  <text x="195" y="602" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You can retake your selfie before submitting.</text>

  <!-- Actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="49" y="622" width="292" height="44" rx="62" fill="url(#brandGradient)" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="195" y="649" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">SUBMIT FOR VERIFICATION</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="49" y="678" width="292" height="44" rx="62" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="705" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#C42936">RETAKE SELFIE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="767" width="390" height="77" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="767" x2="390" y2="767" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,793 49,784 59,793 59,805 39,805" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="35,793 49,781 63,793" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="49" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">HOME</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="792" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>

    <circle cx="127" cy="792" r="3" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <text x="127" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="183" y="784" width="23" height="17" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="188,801 188,807 194,801" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <circle cx="190" cy="792" r="1.5" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <circle cx="197" cy="792" r="1.5" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <text x="195" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#EA5D6B">CHATS</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="274" cy="790" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="274" cy="803" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="274" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
  <g>

    <text x="351" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">SETTINGS</text>
  </g>
</svg>
